The second triangle has a base of 25 feet and a height of 30 feet. And the third triangle has a base of 35 inches and a height of 40 inches. I would like the area of each triangle in their respective units."

height.description: The height of the triangle from the base.

unit.description: The measurement unit for the area. Defaults to square meters.
